title: Codul contravențional al Republicii Moldova
in_force_basis: LP195 din 15.07.10, MO160-162/07.09.10 art.590 (no own day: in force on publication, Art. 76 of the Constitution); newest amendment in force by the archive capture of 2010-09-12
note: Consolidated text of the old State Register of Legal Acts (lex.justice.md, Ministry of Justice), read from the Internet Archive copy named in source. lex.justice.md was replaced by legis.md in 2019 and its last updates date from early 2019; later amendments are not in this record. The register's notes in square brackets are part of its text. Images (the state emblem) are not reproduced.
